description_html:
The OXVA NeXLIM Go Pod Kit is a lightweight, draw-activated pod system with dual mesh coil technology and an 1800mAh battery for all-day vaping. Compact design with LED battery indicator and adjustable airflow.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1800mAh
  • Wattage Range: 5-40W
  • Charging: USB Type-C
  • Activation: Draw-Activated
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 4mL
  • Coil Resistance: Integrated Dual Mesh
  • Airflow: Adjustable (Side Slider)
  • Power Modes: Boost Mode / Eco Mode
  • Pod Compatibility: OXVA NeXLIM Pods (0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.2Ω)
  • Brand: OXVA

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Black Gold, Dark Grey.
